svg.title: Spectrum and truncation error of an epicycle chain
svg.desc: Amplitude spectrum of a 60-sample window and the measured and Parseval truncation error against the number of epicycles kept.
svg.text: Which epicycles to keep: the spectrum and the cost of truncating it
demo process 12, window starting at t = 240 s; frequencies are turns per 60 samples
tall stems: k = +/-1 (memory swing) and +/-5 (5.25 CPU pulses per window)
share of the signal's power held by K terms
measured rms error / rms of the signal
The measured error equals Parseval's prediction to rounding at every K, because the DFT is an orthogonal change of basis (up to the 1/N).
